question: Would saturating at 65,535 or omitting the header repair validator/writer agreement?

criteria.instruction: No. Saturation still reports fewer bytes than a/c intend to emit; removing the header understates encoded size. Compute all additions in a wider checked type, reject over-limit totals, then narrow and allocate from the verified total. Writer and validator share the same full header-plus-payload contract and retain an emitted-byte check.
Cite O16, o24 inspection and repair review; distinguish overflow avoidance from valid bounded acceptance.
Do not clamp/drop payload bytes, silently expand the wire format or report partial output as valid to make sizes agree.
